findings.suggested_fix: Use a grammatically correct and idiomatic Arabic phrase for the section header. Replace "خواطر مبشّر" with "خواطر مبشّر" corrected to "خواطر مبشر" or better "خواطر المبشّر" (preferred: "خواطر المبشّر"). Preserve capitalization and spacing as plain text.

findings.location: paragraph beginning "The early Anabaptists met as many times as they could..." (source) / corresponding paragraph in translation
findings.source_quote: The early Anabaptists met as many times as they could, and that was usually out in the weather, in some woods somewhere.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the inaccurate/inconsistent Arabic phrase for "the early Anabaptists". Replace "الأنابابتيستيات الأُولَى" with a grammatically correct masculine plural form such as "الأنابابتيستيون الأوائل" or "الأنابابتيستيون الأوّلون" to match the English meaning and standard Arabic usage.
findings.translation_quote: الاجتماع كثيرًا ما فعلته الأنابابتيستيات الأُولَى، وكان ذلك عادة في العراء، في بعض الغابات في مكان ما.
